mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_runtime_config_ack (tenant_id, revision, content_hash, instance_id, status, reason, applied_at_ms, created_at_ms, updated_at_ms) VALUES (#{ack.tenantId}, #{ack.revision}, #{ack.contentHash}, #{ack.instanceId}, #{ack.status}, #{ack.reason}, #{ack.appliedAtMs}, #{ack.createdAtMs}, #{ack.updatedAtMs}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE content_hash = IF(VALUES(applied_at_ms) > applied_at_ms OR (VALUES(applied_at_ms) = applied_at_ms AND VALUES(status) = 'APPLIED' AND status <> 'APPLIED'), VALUES(content_hash), content_hash), reason = IF(VALUES(applied_at_ms) > applied_at_ms OR (VALUES(applied_at_ms) = applied_at_ms AND VALUES(status) = 'APPLIED' AND status <> 'APPLIED'), VALUES(reason), reason), updated_at_ms = IF(VALUES(applied_at_ms) > applied_at_ms OR (VALUES(applied_at_ms) = applied_at_ms AND VALUES(status) = 'APPLIED' AND status <> 'APPLIED'), VALUES(updated_at_ms), updated_at_ms), status = IF(VALUES(applied_at_ms) > applied_at_ms OR (VALUES(applied_at_ms) = applied_at_ms AND VALUES(status) = 'APPLIED' AND status <> 'APPLIED'), VALUES(status), status), applied_at_ms = GREATEST(VALUES(applied_at_ms), applied_at_ms)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_runtime_config_ack WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND revision = #{revision} AND status = #{status}
